TO LIFT THE SIGN
The Company is preparing to propose the following key matters for consideration and 
approval at the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders:
•To approve an increase of the registered capital in the amount of THB 151.35 
million  by issuing not exceeding 605.41 million newly issued ordinary shares.
•To approve the issuance and allocation  of not exceeding 231.41 million units of 
NCL-W4 warrants to the existing shareholders of the Company in proportion to 
their respective shareholdings (Rights Offering).
•To approve the allocation of not exceeding 605.41 million newly issued ordinary 
shares, comprising:
-Not exceeding 231.41 million shares to accommodate the exercise of rights 
under the NCL -W4 warrants; and
-Not exceeding 374.00 million shares for offering through Private Placement.The Company’s subsidiary, Golden Supply Co., Ltd., has entered into service 
agreements with NAVANTIA S.A., S.M.E. (NVT) for projects in Thailand, comprising 
two projects as follows:
1)Capability Enhancement for Naval Operations Project , executed on 24 April 2025, with a 
contract value of approximately THB 84.86 million and a project duration of 730 days.
2)Pattani -class OPVs Modernization Project , executed on 26 September 2025, with 
a contract value of approximately THB 381.61 million and a project duration of 1,095 
days.
In Q3/2025, revenue of THB 118.09 million has been recognized, with the remaining 
THB 338.16 million expected to be recognized in subsequent periods. The Company 
anticipates that the revenue recognition will continue progressively and be fully 
completed within three years.
